name: Digit (2020 generation)

source.quote: The company, based in Albany, Oregon, USA, has just revealed the latest iteration of its 'Digit' robot.
we will begin testing their bipedal robot, Digit, for use in our operations

locomotion.note: Amazon's own newsroom names Digit a 'bipedal robot' directly, for the same generation covered by this record's shipped Ford/Amazon/GXO deployments.

timeline.detail: Ford Motor Company becomes Digit's first named commercial customer, testing it for last-mile delivery paired with autonomous vehicles.

source.quote: Ford Motor Company (2020) — First commercial customer; Purpose: explore last-mile delivery

timeline.detail: GXO Logistics deploys Digit at its SPANX facility near Atlanta, Georgia, under a Robots-as-a-Service contract; GXO's own news page shows a photo of the unit and describes it as GXO's most advanced live humanoid deployment.

source.quote: GXO has made the most progress with Digit, a humanoid robot that has been optimized to fit our needs and integrated with other automated technology in the warehouse.

timeline.detail: Amazon begins testing Digit at its own robotics facility for tote recycling; Amazon's own newsroom names itself as the customer and publishes photos of the physical unit working alongside Amazon employees.

source.quote: Broadening our partnership with Agility Robotics, we will begin testing their bipedal robot, Digit, for use in our operations.
picking items on and off an AMR to a conveyor

capabilities.note: GXO's Flowery Branch facility, named customer, 100,000+ totes moved by late 2025. Agility's own page describes the task and separately states the underlying pipeline 'blends traditional control methods, teleoperated demonstrations, policy training, and refinement' -- it does not explicitly say current day-to-day operation runs with no human in the loop, so autonomy is recorded as unknown rather than autonomous, per this dataset's strict rule.

notes: This record covers the hardware generation of Digit that actually shipped to named customers (Ford 2020, Amazon 2023, GXO 2023-2024; Agility also claims a Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada deployment per its own account, not independently sourced here).

No independently sourced height/weight/payload/battery specs for this specific generation were located during this build, so specs is intentionally empty rather than reusing the newer Digit 5 numbers. See agility-digit for the current (Digit 5) generation's claimed specs, which is a different, not-yet-shipped hardware generation.
Digit is sold as Robots-as-a-Service, not a one-time purchase, so price_history is intentionally empty.

Shipped bar applied (2026-09-20): both GXO's own news page (gxo.com, real photo file Digit-image-min.jpg served from GXO's own domain) and Amazon's own newsroom (aboutamazon.com, two photos of the physical unit) name themselves as customers with images of the unit on their own channels, replacing the earlier Wikipedia-sourced GXO citation and adding Amazon as a second named, photographed 2023-2024 delivery of this same generation.

actuator_torque_nm, battery_wh, charge_time_min, sdk, warranty, and order_type were left out (2026-09-21): no independently sourced spec sheet for this specific (2020-2024) hardware generation was located, consistent with the existing note that height/weight/battery specs for this generation are intentionally left unsourced rather than reused from the newer Digit 5. delivery.timeline[].sector set to automotive (Ford) and logistics (GXO, Amazon).
